title: 콧소리 되기 1: 한국말은 왜 [한궁말]일까요?
objective: You can read words like 한국말, 작년 and 박물관 aloud, saying ㄱ as [ㅇ] before ㄴ and ㅁ.
summary: A final ㄱ (batchim) sounds like [ㅇ] when the next syllable starts with ㄴ or ㅁ.

task.title: Read and say it right
task.line: Read each word aloud first, then write or choose how it really sounds.

words.exampleMeaning: I came to Korea last year.
I'm going to a museum this weekend.

words.meaning: the youngest child in a family
words.exampleMeaning: I'm the youngest in my family.

letters.as: Same change before ㅁ: 한국말 [한궁말], 박물관 [방물관]
Also works when a particle follows: 수박만 [수방만]
No 'ng' here; ㄱ joins the next vowel: 한국어 [한구거]

exercises: Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 국민 ② 식물 ③ 백년
Does the ㄱ change to [ㅇ]? Write Yes or No: ① 국내 ② 학원 ③ 작문
Choose the right sound: ① 백만 (a) [뱅만] (b) [백만] ② 먹는 (a) [먹는] (b) [멍는] ③ 목요일 (a) [모교일] (b) [몽요일]
Find the word where ㄱ sounds like [ㅇ] and write its sound: ① 오늘은 약을 먹어요. ② 물 주세요. 목말라요. ③ 이 책을 사요.
answers: ① Yes [궁내] ② No [하권] ③ Yes [장문]
